Sam (Support): Heads-up: OrbitPay onboarding stalled. Two issues seen during initial load: tenant provisioning hit rate-limits (429s) and a model-quality regression on rerank causing wrong top-k results. They're doing a staging cert. Renewal ~36 days. Can CS escalate? INC-8124
Renee (CSM): Acknowledged. Sandbox only? Need a short impact blurb for account health and whether this blocks cutover.
Sam (Support): Staging only but they mirror prod. Logs: `provisioner: rate_limit_exceeded tenant=orbitpay status=429` and rerank logs: `reranker: score_swap top1=expected:acct_name got:acct_id`. Looks like rerank model variant mismatch.
Diego (CS Ops): Ok splitting owners: provisioning throughput -> Eng, rerank model/safe-rollback -> CS Ops + Eng. I can prep a re-run and a quality-check job once Eng pins the model variant. Backfill estimate for re-run: 2-4h.
Renee (CSM): @Priya can Eng increase tenant quota or apply a short-lived burst permission? We need a stopgap so customer can finish validation. Also need a comms plan for the model quality issue.
Priya (Eng): Triage: rate limiter tripped because their onboarding job parallelized too many connections. Mitigations: 1) temporarily bump tenant rate limit (ops toggle) 2) provide a recommended ingestion window and a client-side backoff. I can bump limit for 2 hours now. For rerank, looks like they pulled an older model variant (v2-rerank-beta) by mistake. We'll pin them to v2-rerank-stable and re-run. Hotfix/ops ETA: set limit + pin = ~45m. Longer-term: add guard to warn on non-stable variants.
Sam (Support): Ticket INC-8124 updated with logs and sample payloads. ticket-bot: status -> escalated to CS + Eng.
Renee (CSM): Draft comms: "Hi Jordan  We're seeing two problems during staging ingest: (1) provisioning rate-limits causing intermittent failures; (2) reranker variant mismatch leading to incorrect top results. Immediate: we'll temporarily raise your ingestion quota and re-pin the rerank model to stable, then re-run validation. Expect quota bump + pin within 1h and rerun plan within 4h. We'll schedule a 30m sync in the next 90m." OK to send?
Mark (Renewals): Please flag renewal tracker: risk = Medium until validation completes. If we can't get cert in 72h, escalate to AE.
Diego (CS Ops): For rerank re-run I'll prepare a QC job: `qc-rerank -t orbitpay --verify-topk 5 --report=summary`. Estimate run 2-3h depending on dataset. Will make a one-click job link.
Priya (Eng): Ops command to bump quota for tenant `orbitpay`: `POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/orbitpay/actions/set_quota -d '{\"ingest_rate\":2000}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer <ops>\"`. I'm applying a 2-hour temporary bump now and pinning rerank variant to `v2-rerank-stable`. Will report back in ~15m.
Renee (CSM): Internal comms bullets (short):
- Immediate: Temporary ingest quota bump + pin rerank to stable  owner: Eng (Priya)  ETA: 0-1h
- Short-term: Re-run validation + QC job  owner: CS Ops (Diego)  ETA: 2-4h
- Customer sync: 30m within 90m  owner: CSM (Renee)
- Renewal note: Mark to update tracker (risk = Medium)
Sam (Support): Attached sanitized logs and failing request IDs. :white_check_mark:
ticket-bot: INC-8124 comment added: "Escalated to CS + Eng. Suspect tenant rate-limit + rerank variant mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Mark (Renewals): Added account health note and set renewal to Monitoring. Will escalate if validation slips past 72h.
Priya (Eng): Quota bump + variant pin done for `orbitpay`. Monitoring ingestion metrics and rerank outputs now. :rocket:
Diego (CS Ops): Building QC job and runbook, will post link in thread in ~20m.
Renee (CSM): Thanks all. I'll send the customer note and book the 30m sync for ~11:00am PT. Owning comms until validation passes. Ping me if any regression.
